Dawn Buckingham

Republican candidate for Commissioner of the General Land Office, Texas · Incumbent

Texas Land Commissioner; physician (eye surgeon)

Dawn Buckingham is the Republican incumbent Texas Land Commissioner and has held the office since January 2023. She previously served in the Texas Senate for District 24 from 2017 to 2023. She was unopposed in the March 3, 2026 Republican primary and is running for a second term in the November 3, 2026 general election.

Background

  • Texas Land Commissioner, 2023–present (elected November 2022; first woman to hold the office)
  • Texas Senate, District 24, 2017–2023
  • Lake Travis ISD school board member, 2014–2015
  • Physician/surgeon before entering public office
  • B.S., University of Texas at Austin
  • M.D., University of Texas Medical Branch, Galveston

Also running for Commissioner of the General Land Office

  • Benjamin Flores Democratic
  • Neill Snider Libertarian
